paper.title: Dissecting cell identity via network inference and in silico gene perturbation

scientific_task: Read the whole original Figure 1 as a generic CellOracle workflow plus mouse haematopoiesis application, distinguishing inferred regulatory models, computational perturbation and state-direction outputs.

relations.type: comparison, not training feedback or all-edge validation

visual_decomposition.layout: Original Figure 1 has a workflow panel above mouse-haematopoiesis embeddings, differentiation/simulation fields and score summaries. The new three-panel diagram reorganizes inference, computational prediction and separate experiment comparisons for the explicitly selected zebrafish case.
visual_decomposition.meaning: Workflow arrows represent stated data/computation/assay flow. The dashed arrow supplies a prediction to the evidence comparison; it does not validate every TF–target edge.
visual_decomposition.limits: No original field, embedding points, heatmap, edge list, statistics or time-lapse lineage trace is recreated. Figure 1 mouse scATAC inputs are not imported into the zebrafish promoter-only application.
visual_decomposition.transfer: Original editable text/nodes and scoped comparisons with synchronized caption/spec.

transferable_rules: Keep inferred candidate/fitted networks distinct from individually established causal regulatory effects.
State application-specific model inputs instead of copying generic multimodal cartoons into every case.
Represent computational TF shifts, observed-neighbour references and biological perturbation/control groups as distinct objects.
Preserve stage qualifiers when a source reports different responses across developmental stages.
Distinguish measured composition/annotation/density agreement from direct lineage tracking and all-edge causal validation.
Keep cells, embryo pools, biological replicates and technical replicates separate; retain incompatible source scopes until reconciled by evidence.
nontransferable: Specific zebrafish phenotype directions or stages as universal TF effects.
Mouse scATAC inputs or same-cell paired modalities as required inputs for the zebrafish example.
Original raster artwork, inferred edge lists, vector fields, numerical run settings or quantitative results.
Qualitative phenotype concordance as proof of clinical effects, every causal edge or all-future-perturbation reliability.

known_gaps.claim: The selected noto run used a particular numeric expression shift, iteration setting or hyperparameter configuration.
known_gaps.reason: Exact selected-run files and code were outside scope. The general Methods describe defaults and say zebrafish analysis used defaults, but that is not a run-level audit.
known_gaps.effect: No numeric run settings should be added as independently verified.

known_gaps.claim: Approximately 25 embryos/sample and 40–50 crispants/experiment can be reconciled into one assay count.
known_gaps.reason: The reviewed text does not map preparation units to individual final sequenced pools.
known_gaps.effect: Keep the existing scoped ambiguity; no universal embryo count is certified.

known_gaps.claim: Readout composition change tracks lineage conversion of individual cells or validates every TF-to-target edge.
known_gaps.reason: Figure 4 displays cluster composition, annotations and density projections; no corresponding lineage-tracing or edge-wise assay was inspected.
known_gaps.effect: The figure correctly avoids these conclusions.

known_gaps.claim: The complete simulation and phenotype statistics reproduce from raw data.
known_gaps.reason: No raw-data, implementation-code, model rerun, replicate-level statistical or rescue analysis was performed.
known_gaps.effect: Report source-supported qualitative directions, not independent numerical replication.

known_gaps.claim: All source figures or experiments were comprehensively audited.
known_gaps.reason: Actual pixel review covered Figure 1 and its panel-a detail, and all Figure 4 a–g. Figure 3 and Extended Data 11 were assessed through full relevant captions/results only.
known_gaps.effect: No claim of paper-wide expert validation.

known_gaps.claim: The deliverable is editable and contains no reused source pixels by provenance.
known_gaps.reason: Only rendered images and caption were inspected; editable/generator sources were intentionally excluded. The rendered drawing visually contains boxes and text without obvious reproduced source plots.
known_gaps.effect: Visual observation does not independently certify source-file editability or production provenance.
